name: Raindrop Detection Plate
description: Like an umbrella sensor! Interleaved copper traces short together when raindrops fall on the plate.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an umbrella sensor! Interleaved copper traces short together when raindrops fall on the plate.
wiringGuidance: Connect sensing plate to amplifier board. Connect amplifier VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and A0 (Yellow) to analog pin A0.
commonMistakes: Submerging the electronic comparator module instead of only the probe plate.
Leaving water droplet residue on the probe tracks between tests.

miniExperiment.title: Storm Raindrop Alarm
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, A0 to Analog Pin A0.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Outputs near 0 when dry; a single raindrop placed on the plate jumps the value to 700+.
